items.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
items.title_cn: 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉解释了他为何要求6万名员工离职
items.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
items.summary_cn: 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉（Satya Nadella）解释了他为何在10月份向6万名员工提供买断方案的原因，这实际上是在敦促他们自愿离职，而不是通过另一次大规模裁员来削减员工队伍。简短的答案是人工智能，但并不是你想象的那样。

items.title: Elon Musk says: ‘I’m not MAGA’
items.title_cn: 埃隆·马斯克表示：“我不是MAGA。”
items.summary: During his appearance Wednesday at The New York Times' DealBook Summit, Elon Musk said that he wasn't sure what the term "MAGA" meant and also commented that he felt "pretty foolish" for having spent so much money during the U.S. midterms.
items.summary_cn: 埃隆·马斯克周三在《纽约时报》的DealBook峰会上亮相时表示，他不确定“MAGA”一词的含义，并表示他觉得在美国中期选举期间花费这么多钱“相当愚蠢”。

items.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
items.title_cn: 在人们对人工智能网络攻击的担忧中，萨蒂亚·纳德拉表示，许多关键基础设施“无法修补”
items.summary: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.
items.summary_cn: 微软首席执行官淡化了最近的Outlook宕机事件，同时指出，人工智能既为保障大部分互联世界带来了机遇，也带来了新的挑战。
